about_the_game:
A new costume for Armin is added.
Suspenders for Armin. Enjoy battles and daily life sections in new fashion.

▼How to use
You can access the new costume by performing either of the following:
1. Select "Another Mode" on the main menu, and then select the character.
Change into the new costume by selecting "Character Editor" when you are near the tent on the field.
2. Select "Story Mode" on the main menu, and then approach the character in the Daily Life section.
Change into the new costume by selecting "Change outfit" when you are near the character.
